summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, containing a press release reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. This is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 2.02. The release covers revenue of $2,034 million, adjusted EBITDA of $317.7 million, GAAP net income of $104.8 million, and reaffirmed 2026 guidance. No transactional or special-situations event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review—is described or indicated. The filing is an ordinary periodic financial update with no event-driven implications for special-situations analysis.
